payout_value_note: $75 cash per qualifying referral; up to 10 referrals ($750) per calendar year
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($75-$75 per referral); time: referral share est. 5-15 min active
steps: Referrer registers for the program online, agrees to terms, and submits email/phone for each referred person. Friend receives email/text, opens a new personal or business checking account within 90 days, keeps it 60+ days, and completes eStatements, recurring direct deposit, and $200+ debit spend within 60 days of account opening.
catches: Referrer must register for the program online at the official referral center, agree to the Terms and Conditions, and submit valid email and phone for both parties. The referred person must provide the same email address entered in the Referral Center when opening the account. Only one referrer may receive the bonus per referred person (first to enter wins). Not available if the referred person already has a 1st Advantage checking account. Minimum opening deposit or direct deposit required on all checking accounts.
biggest_catch: Referrer must register for the program online at the official referral center, agree to the Terms and Conditions, and submit valid email and phone for both parties. The referred person must provide the same email address entered in the Referral Center when opening the account. Only one referrer may receive the bonus per referred person (first to enter wins). Not available if the referred person already has a 1st Advantage checking account. Minimum opening deposit or direct deposit required on all checking accounts.
eligibility: Friend: no existing 1st Advantage checking account, opens a new personal or business checking account within 90 days of receiving the referral email/text, keeps the account open and in good standing at least 60 days, and within 60 days of account opening: signs up for eStatements, has a recurring direct deposit, and spends $200+ on the 1st Advantage Debit Mastercard
timing: 4-6 weeks after all conditions are met; direct deposited into the referrer's account.
notes: Official Refer A Friend Terms & Conditions (1stadvantage.org, fetched 2026-09-23): 'The person making the referral (Referrer) will earn a $75 cash bonus via direct deposit for each individual or business referred' and 'A Referrer may receive up to ten (10) direct deposits in increments of $75 ($750 value) within a calendar year.'
